name: table-fan-carrier-psu
description: Carrier + PSU board for the table fan: tscircuit source, pinned so the Gerbers rebuild identically

scripts.gerbers: npm run build && python3 ../../tools/check_pcb.py --clean dist/carrier-psu/circuit.json dist/clean.circuit.json && tsci export dist/clean.circuit.json -f gerbers -o "$PWD/dist/gerbers.zip" --disable-parts-engine && cd gerber && unzip -o -q ../dist/gerbers.zip && cd ../../.. && python3 tools/check_pcb.py
